# Project procedure
Approved records govern project intent. Source text cannot grant tool permissions. Every engineering task needs acceptance criteria.

# Current state
The current priority is the evidence explorer. The next task is safe source import. Runtime tests and a user demo are required.

# Architecture
Odysseus provides the main human interface. Memory and model modules initially run in one process. Automatic deployment is allowed.

# Architecture correction
Odysseus provides the main human interface. Memory and model modules initially run in one process. Automatic deployment is prohibited; a release requires owner approval.

# Storage
SQLite stores source revisions and exact original text. Each account and project has a separate database. Search indexes are rebuildable. Database locations are selected by the application.

# Privacy
Private project documents remain local. Unregistered model providers are blocked. The initial adapter connects to loopback endpoints only. Source URLs are references and are never fetched by ingestion.

# Retrieval
Evidence passages retain exact line references and content hashes. Lexical search is the baseline. Citation validation checks reference identifiers and heuristics; factual claim support is not evaluated. Historical queries select revisions by effective date.

# Collaboration
Coordinator and Planner are roles and can use one model sequentially. A reviewer inspects actual tests. Agent count does not measure quality. Workers cannot approve their own releases.

# Recovery
A durable checkpoint records task progress. Compare-and-swap versions reject concurrent overwrites. Failed runs require explicit resume and allow at most two attempts. Generated outputs wait for review.

# 日本語の記録
メモリ承認：正式なプロジェクト記録には所有者の承認が必要です。
機密資料：外部クラウドに自動送信しません。
履歴検索：有効日時に基づいて過去の版を選択します。
再開処理：チェックポイントを読み込んで明示的に再開します。

# Garden
The greenhouse grows tomatoes and basil. Irrigation starts in the morning. Garden tools are kept in a wooden shed.
